source: Standard API prices as of 2026-10-09 provided by the user (OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol and Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5 pricing pages). Claude Opus 5.5 added on 2026-10-10 from the Claude API documentation bundled with Claude Code (claude-api skill: models.md, prompt-caching.md): input $4, output $20, cache read $0.20, cache write 1.25x (5m) and 2x (1h) of input. GPT-6 Astra added on 2026-10-10 from the OpenAI API pricing page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, standard tier): input $10, cached input $1, cache write $12.50, output $50; over 272K input tokens: input $20, cached input $2, cache write $25, output $75.
notes: Codex does not report cache writes; input not read from cache is priced as uncached input.
GPT-6.1 Sol bills the whole request at the long-context price when one request's input exceeds 272K tokens. The long-context cache read price was not given and stays null, so such tokens fail closed.
Claude Code reports cache writes with a 1h or 5m split; an unsplit write has no price and fails closed.
GPT-6 Astra uses the same 272K long-context rule as GPT-6.1 Sol. Codex does not report cache writes, so the Astra cache write prices are not used and stay null like Sol's.
